name: kanji2koe-openjtalk
description: OpenJTalk/jpreprocess based Japanese text to AquesTalk phoneme notation converter for WebAssembly

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/aqkanji2koe-wasm --target web --release --out-dir ../../pkg && node scripts/prepare-wasm-package.mjs
scripts.docs:build: npm run build && npm --prefix docs-src install && npm --prefix docs-src run build
scripts.docs:dev: npm run build && npm --prefix docs-src install && npm --prefix docs-src run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0
